text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's the Takarazuka Kinen!
I'll bring glory to my home turf in Kansai and wrap up spring in style!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you know what our goal is this time, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Make sure the strategy's solid. I'm winnin' this!
I'm definitely winnin'! I'll win and give hope to my family!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I win, Dad will definitely get back on his feet!
First, I gotta lead the charge for my family.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And also—one more thing. I gotta show my running
to that kid from the local circuit, too.
Yes, about "that person from the regional circuit"...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, Tama! Did you really
see me as that much of a rival?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geh, Inari?! You're in this race too?!

This Umamusume is Inari One. She hails from
regional Ohi, a dyed-in-the-wool Edokko through and through.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's the big idea?! You just called me
'that kid from the countryside,'
dang it all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Not you! Even if you're from the regional circuit,
you're in Tokyo, so you've got it made!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this works out great.
Inari, it's time for an East-West showdown!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, I'll make 'em realize what I'm made of.
The true grit of a girl raised in Naniwa!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! You're the one who's gonna be cryin',
you knucklehead!

With Oguri Cap watching on, an unexpected showdown
with Inari One suddenly materialized. For the sake of my family,
I cannot afford to lose.
